== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Begin Landing Your Troops & Dark Forces]] (<code>1291_9</code>, Virtual Block 9.1), showing the '''PC-E1 (title)''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The new title; the game text is unchanged (as on the PC card image). The text box was placed by hand: CardMaker set this long text above the banner, so the text layer of a render was moved down into the text box of a render without text (same renderer, same fonts).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p879652 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 2 May 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p879652
* '''PC-E1 (title) text:''' “Deploy on table. Your [Separatist] droids are power +1 and may shuttle from battleground systems for free. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to cancel and redraw your just-drawn destiny. Once per turn, each player may ignore any deploy cost on [Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step and once per game, while that Objective on table, you may take a starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or draw two cards from Reserve Deck). Jedi Tests may not modify your battle or weapon destiny draws. Lost if your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 (title) game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB9-04-Begin_Landing_Your_Troops_The_Dark_Path-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
